basic_info.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
basic_info.about:
I am currently an Embedded Software Engineer at ULA. 

I was recently an Aerospace and Software Engineer at ASTRA, specializing in Mission Operations. 

Previously, I was a Software Engineer with Sierra Nevada Corporation's Flight Software group, where I developed software to manage autonomy and automation functions for the  Dream Chaser spacecraft. 

Before that, I was with Emergent Space Technologies embedded at Lockheed Martin working as a Software Engineer on the Orion multi-purpose crew vehicle in the Guidance, Navigation, and Control group. I was responsible for software that performs data processing and Fault Detection, Isolation, and Recovery for the Barometric Altimeters and GPS Receivers. Also with Emergent, I worked as a Software Engineer for NASA Goddard's Orbit Determination Toolbox, a tool that provides a way to do early mission analysis for formation flying and exploration systems. Before that, at the Space Dynamics Laboratory, I did Systems Engineering for an ISS-based deployment system to create and maintain constellations of small satellites.

No matter the size, complexity, or scope of the project, I love being able to use modern technology to solve aerospace problems. The projects that I have been involved in range from a single, small, sub-orbital experiment, to strings and constellations of Earth-orbiting satellites, to large spacecraft to carry humans from the Earth to the Moon and back. Modern technology has revolutionized the way that we approach many aspects of these engineering feats. I enjoy being able to contribute my knowledge and talents to these problem-solving endeavors.

I have a Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering and a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering with an emphasis in Aerospace Engineering (and a minor in Portuguese) from Utah State University.

I'm always interested in hearing from former colleagues, managers, and classmates. Feel free to contact me if you'd like to connect.

experience.title: Senior Aerospace and Software Engineer
experience.description:
• Lead the development of Mission Analysis for Satellites Toolkit (MAST) to perform mission operations and analysis functions (such as satellite tracking, overpass prediction and reservation, and mission planning) vital to the success of ASTRA’s satellite programs
    • Served as Subject Matter Expert for mission operations and orbit analysis for satellites and satellite constellations 
    • Developed automated test scripts for spacecraft and payload hardware acceptance, functional, and comprehensive tests
    • Implemented software interfaces and data analysis for 2D and 3D cameras into sun-tracking radiometer and Lidar bathymetry drone platforms, respectively
    • Provided technical guidance and leadership to incorporate Docker, peer reviews, and other best-practices into software development ecosystem
    • Performed system level spacecraft design for small satellite concepts
    • Developed sequence diagrams for satellite mission ConOps
    • Wrote user guides and documentation to instruct others on installation and operation of developed software
    • Wrote and edited SBIR, STTR, NAIC, and IR&D proposals

experience.title: Software Engineer (AS&C SAFM Software Engineer)
experience.description:
• Designed and implemented Qt graphical user interface to assist in the input, management, and verification of Condition Monitors (CMON) and Action Sequences (ASEQ) for Dream Chaser spacecraft
• Developed Python script to generate easily-reviewed LaTeX documentation based on computer-generated information and human-created design narratives
• Created script in Python to translate input CMON and ASEQ to Timeliner programming language to be used by Dream Chaser flight computers
• Wrote user guides and documentation to instruct others on installation and operation of developed software

experience.title: Aerospace Engineer
experience.description:
Software Engineer for Lockheed Martin's Orion Multi-Purpose Crew Vehicle in the Guidance, Navigation, and Control group
• Designed, implemented, and tested flight software in Matlab/Simulink to perform data processing and Fault Detection, Isolation, and Recovery (FDIR) for Barometric Altimeters and GPS Receivers
• Oversaw and incorporated all modifications made by navigation team, performed necessary testing, and maintained compatibility with overall system during major navigation system re-architecture
• Collaborated on and improved software to support Antares, a Trick-based simulation environment
• Developed Python scripts to interface with LaTeX documentation and Git revision control systems to enhance, automate, and simplify workflow
• Facilitated the implementation of new technologies (LaTeX, Git) and methodologies (Agile/Scrum) in the navigation software development team
• Developed software in Perl programming language to identify changes in sampling ports between releases of Lockheed Martin's Orion flight software
• Created test cases for the verification and validation of software on Lockheed Martin's Orion capsule

Software Engineer working on NASA Goddard's Orbit Determination Toolbox (ODTBX)
• Abstracted code from ODTBX to expand link budget calculation capability and prepare for object-oriented re-architecture
• Added the capability to handle general solve-for and consider parameters to estimators in ODTBX
• Developed user interface to facilitate ground station selection for ODTBX
• Packaged, tested, and delivered ODTBX releases for use on Linux, Windows, and Mac

experience.title: Coordinator
experience.company: Utah State University Get Away Special team
experience.description:
• Coordinated team of 30 interdisciplinary students to develop space research projects
• Led team through experiment development and successful flight on NASA's Weightless Wonder reduced-gravity aircraft in Houston
• Supervised development of CubeSat and experiments for International Space Station
• Organized design reviews and consistently monitored team progress
• Wrote and edited proposals and technical reports to NASA
• Presented work at:
    - Rocky Mountain NASA Space Grant Consortium Meetings
    - 5th Annual CubeSat Developers' Summer Workshop at AIAA/USU SmallSat Conference 
    - 5th Annual CubeSat Developers' Workshop at CalPoly in San Luis Obispo
